summary: Authored the twelve cranial-nerve records (CN I-XII) with honest schematic geometry, registered every id first, and added a gate that counts them. FILES: (1) NEW src/data/structures/telencephalon-cranial-nerves.json (CN I, CN II; region telencephalon); (2) NEW src/data/structures/brainstem-cranial-nerves.json (CN III-IV midbrain, V-VIII pons, IX-XII medulla) — both picked up automatically by load.ts glob './structures/*.json', no loader edit; (3) src/data/taxonomy.json appended 12 one-object-per-line rows, 236 -> 248 rows, 6 -> 7 kinds, all region/subdivision 'Cranial nerves'/kind 'nerve'/laterality paired/color #14b8a6; (4) src/data/webRefs.ts 12 curated entries (the automatic fallback would have produced an empty panel from a name like 'CN I Olfactory nerve'); (5) NEW scripts/verify/cranial-nerves.mjs, 451 assertions, exit 0, 0.4 s. CONTENT: each record carries number+name+Latin synonyms, TRUE region (telencephalon 2, midbrain 2, pons 4, medulla 4 — the taxonomy is the authority, and CN II follows the committed v8 optic-pathway rows into telencephalon, stated explicitly), one subdivision that groups all twelve inside each region, kind 'nerve', laterality, colour, modality, function, connections that LINK the existing ids (nuc-oculomotor, nuc-edinger-westphal, nuc-trochlear, the four trigeminal nuclei+2 tracts, nuc-abducens, nuc-facial, nuc-superior-salivatory, nuc-solitarius-rostral/caudal, nuc-dmv, nuc-ambiguus, nuc-hypoglossal, the 4 vestibular+2 cochlear nuclei, tract-optic-nerve/ctx-optic-chiasm/tract-optic-tract/nuc-lgn/nuc-pretectal), the surf-cn3..12-exit landmarks, the vessels that are clinically load-bearing (PCom/AICA/PICA/vertebral/labyrinthine/ACA), 50 clinical items with palsy picture + localisation, level anchors (24, all resolving), refs and a per-record contextNote stating exactly what geometry stands behind it. GEOMETRY HONESTY: all twelve are meshes:false with an authored origin3d+size3d (radii > 0, every extent inside CLIP_BOUNDS), 0 manifest parts, 0 section parts, no GLB added, no BP3D element registered — anatomy still 138 parts / 599204 tris / 13.82 MiB. assets-src/ was searched: NO BP3D nerve element exists beyond the already-baked CN II pair (already reported in PLAN.md section 1), nothing was baked. SLUG DECISION: the frozen contract was extended with a documented 'nrv-' prefix (^(nuc|tract|vent|surf|vasc|ctx|nrv)-[a-z0-9-]+$, the platform task's scripts/validate-data.mjs line 43 now carries it, and the gate PARSES that regex out of the validator and executes it rather than re-typing it), because prefix-follows-kind is the stated contract in DATA_CONTRACT.md and reusing an existing prefix would create the one class of row where prefix and kind disagree. VERIFIED, all executed and printing numbers: node scripts/verify/cranial-nerves.mjs 451/451 exit 0 (12 rows=12 authored records, meshes:false 12/12, placements inside bounds 12/12, 24 level refs, 131 id tokens resolved, 0 manifest/section parts, 50 clinical items, regions 2/2/4/4); npm run validate 0 errors / 0 warnings with 248 rows and 'nerve 12' in the per-kind histogram; npm run check exit 0; npm run build exit 0; verify:pipeline 138/138 parts 599204 tris 0 problems; verify:plane 10827 assertions; verify:plane-helper-extent 206/206; verify:somatotopy 45/45; verify:cortical-lobes 564/564; verify:pip-contract exit 0; verify:division-toggles 251/251; verify:view-filter-consistency 102/102 (sweeps 225 structures); verify:audit-checks 92/0; verify:closure-bite 7/7 mutations caught; verify:boundary-contract 22/22; verify:a11y-contract 28/28; verify:budget-report 599204 tris / 13.82 MiB / headroom 0.18 MiB; verify-imaging-v4.mjs and verify-imaging-v4b.mjs exit 0 (package.json has no verify:imaging-v4 script — run them by path); build-anatomy-geometry.mjs --manifest scene 599204/800000 PASS. RED AT BASE, NOT MINE: verify:anatomy exits 1 on spawnSync powershell EPERM (0 assertions run, environment), verify:imaging-fit likewise, verify:audit exits 4 because Chrome cannot start, verify:area-toggles reads 228 passed / 27 failed — 2 more than the PLAN's baseline 25 because the new kind makes the Systems row 7 buttons where the pre-v12 expectation says 6 (and the per-area sum reads 234 vs 248); both are inside the already-red v12 header contract and no product change was made to satisfy them. DEVIATIONS FROM PLAN.md: (a) the twelve records live in TWO files (telencephalon-cranial-nerves.json + brainstem-cranial-nerves.json) instead of the single cranial-nerves.json of PLAN section 4 — this task's exclusive write scope names those two files, and no loader or validator change is needed for either; (b) modality and course are JSON-only fields on the records (my write scope excludes src/types.ts and scripts/validate-data.mjs, which the platform task owns) — the required optional 'modality?: string' on StructureRecord and the matching checkString call in validateStructure are NOT yet present, so those two fields are currently invisible to tsc and unchecked by the validator; my gate asserts both for all twelve, and the platform task or the integrator should add the two lines (the records already carry the fields, so nothing else would change). HANDOFF — OUTSIDE MY WRITE SCOPE, neither doc was touched: docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md line 90 still states the six-prefix slug contract and its coordinate table still claims -22..22 / -55..45 / -18..18 while the validator enforces -58..58 / -55..116 / -76..72; docs/CONTENT_INVENTORY.md lines 59-60 carry the third copy of the slug contract and a stale registry count (179/236).
